En handelsvirksomhed er kendetegnet ved,: A trading company is characterized by the fact that it sells the same goods to customers that it has purchased from suppliers, without actual processing.
Der findes to slags handelsvirksomheder,: There are two types of trading companies, namely:
En engrosvirksomhed eller en grossist er: A wholesale company or a wholesaler is a trading company that resells goods to other companies. The goods are purchased from various manufacturers in large quantities, after which they are resold in smaller quantities to various retail outlets. Since both wholesalers and retailers are businesses, the market in which wholesalers sell goods is called the B2B market (Business to Business).
En handelsvirksomhed (engrosvirksomhed o: A trading company (wholesale and retail) purchases finished goods, which it resells to its customers without changing the goods.

Der findes engrosvirksomheder inden for: There are wholesale companies in many different industries, but these companies are often not well known to ordinary Danes, as wholesale companies usually have no contact with the final consumer.
Ahlsell (tidligere Sanistål) er leverand: Ahlsell (formerly Sanistål) is supplier of installation products, tools and machines for professionals in the brewing industry, while Dagrofa Foodservice is a leading total supplier to the foodservice sector in Denmark.
En detailvirksomhed eller en detaillist: A retail company or a retail list is a trading company that sells goods directly to consumers. Retail companies purchase the goods directly from the manufacturers or through wholesalers. When retail stores sell to consumers, the market in which retail stores sell goods is called the B2C (Business to Consumer) market.
Detailvirksomhedens markedsopgave er sto: The market task of the retail company is largely the same as that of the wholesale company. An important difference, however, is that the retail company's customers are private consumers. The location of the company is therefore of great importance for the sales opportunities.
Supermarkeder, tøjbutikker, byggemarkede: Supermarkets, clothing stores, hardware stores and furniture stores are examples of retail stores. In many cases, the retail trade is organized in chains such as Imerco, Søstrene Grene, Intersport and Skoringen.
Handelsvirksomheden har kun ét varelager: The trading company has only one warehouse. The inventory can be on the shelves in the store and/or in warehouses. The goods are taken out of the warehouse when they are sold and delivered to the customers. No processing of the goods takes place while they are in the company.
Der er to tendenser i handelsstrukturen:: There are two trends in the trade structure:
E-butikker gør det muligt at spare tid,: E-shops make it possible to save time, find information and shop regardless of opening hours. Physical stores often act as showrooms where customers get information and service. In practice, online stores and physical stores complement each other, and companies often use both sales channels.
En servicevirksomhed fremstiller og sælg: A service company produces and sells services. They are also called services. A service company does not produce and sell goods, but performs various tasks for its customers/clients.
En stor del af den offentlige sektor bes: A large part of the public sector consists of service companies, e.g. hospitals, schools, kindergartens, DSB and Banedanmark.
Som eksempler på servicevirksomheder i d: Examples of service companies in the private sector include hairdressing salons, advertising agencies, accountants, lawyers, dentists, gyms, amusement parks, banks and insurance companies.
Servicevirksomhedens kunder kan være off: The service company's customers can be public or private companies as well as private consumers. A service company's services cannot be manufactured and placed on inventory. This means that the company must have sufficient capacity to meet customers' needs exactly at the times when they arise. It is therefore difficult to judge the quality of the service in advance, as production and consumption take place simultaneously.
Antallet af servicevirksomheder og antal: The number of service companies and the number of people employed in the service sector has been increasing strongly in Denmark over the past 10-15 years. This is because consumers increasingly demand services such as entertainment, travel, advice and care. This has happened in tandem with the fact that the information society has replaced the industrial society, where today there is a great focus on information, knowledge and a growing service sector.
En servicevirksomhed sælger serviceydels: A service company sells services, i.e. that it is not a tangible product.
Nogle virksomheder har aktiviteter inden: Some companies have activities in several areas. This applies, for example, to many hairdressing salons, which in addition to selling the service "hairdressing" also sell e.g. shampoo and wax. In the same way, many fitness centers also sell e.g. sportswear and energy drinks in addition to the "exercise" service. These are companies that have both service and trading activities. Companies that have activities in several areas are called mixed companies.
Mange håndværksvirksomheder som fx murer: Many craft companies, such as bricklayers and carpenters, in addition to the "repair work" service, also sell real estate, which they have built at their own expense with a view to selling. These are companies that have both service and production activities.
De fleste bagere har til deres bageri ti: Most bakers have a bakery attached to their bakery, where milk and butter are also sold. This is a company that has both production and trading activities.

En enkeltmandsvirksomhed ejes af én enke: A sole proprietorship is owned by a single person. Sole proprietorships are mainly found in retail trade and crafts.
Hvis Rikke vælger enkeltmandsvirksomhed: If Rikke chooses sole proprietorship as the form of ownership, she is personally liable for the company's debts.
Personlig hæftelse betyder, at Rikke hæf: Personal liability means that Rikke is liable for everything she owns.
Hvis virksomheden går fallit, risikerer: If the company goes bankrupt, she risks losing her entire fortune, which may include, for example, a house, apartment and car.
I en enkeltmandsvirksomhed hæfter ejeren: In a sole proprietorship, the owner is personally liable for the company's debts.
Enkeltmandsvirksomheden er en udbredt ej: The sole proprietorship is a widespread form of ownership in Denmark, especially among small businesses.
Ifølge Danmarks Statistik havde ca. ⅓ af: According to Statistics Denmark, approx. ⅓ of all companies this form of ownership in 2022.
I et interessentskab er der to eller fle: In a partnership there are two or more owners of the business.
Hvis Rikke ønsker at drive sin virksomhe: If Rikke wants to run his business as a partnership, it will require Rikke to find a partner or partner.
Det skal fremgå af firmanavnet, at der e: It must be clear from the company name that it is a partnership. This is done by adding the abbreviation I/S to the company name.
Ejerne kaldes interessenter, og de hæfte: The owners are called stakeholders, and they are personally and jointly liable for the company's debts.
Personlig hæftelse betyder, at både Rikk: Personal liability means that both Rikke and her partner are liable for the company's debts with their entire assets. Joint and several liability means that Rikke and her partner are both liable for the company's entire debt. If the company cannot pay its part of the debt, Rikke must pay the whole.
I et interessentskab hæfter ejerne perso: In a partnership, the owners are personally and jointly liable for the company's debts.
Ejerformen interessentskab er ikke så ud: The ownership form of partnership is not that widespread, as only approx. 3% of all Danish companies in 2022 were registered as an I/S.
Reglerne om anpartsselskaber findes også: The rules on limited liability companies are also found in the Companies Act. A limited company has one or more owners, i.e. persons or companies that own the shares in the company.
Et anpartsselskab er en selvstændig juri: A private limited company is an independent legal entity where the owners are only liable for their contributed capital.
Anpartsselskabet skal have en direktion,: The private limited company must have an executive board, which can be supplemented by a board of directors or a supervisory board. According to the legislation, an ApS must keep accounts and submit its annual report digitally.
Reglerne for anpartsselskaber er altså n: The rules for limited liability companies are therefore almost the same as for limited liability companies. The word limited company or the abbreviation ApS must be included in the company name.
Hvis Rikke vælger at etablere et anparts: If Rikke chooses to establish a limited company, she must, according to the Companies Act, deposit a minimum of DKK 20,000. It can be in the form of cash or other valuables.
Et ApS skal føre regnskab og indberette: An ApS must keep accounts and report the annual report digitally.
I et anpartsselskab hæfter anpartshavern: In a joint-stock company, the shareholders have limited liability for the company's debts.
Anpartsselskabet er den mest anvendte ej: The private limited company is the most used form of ownership among Danish companies.
Ifølge Danmarks Statistik var lige godt: According to Statistics Denmark, just over half of all companies in 2022 were limited liability companies.
Reglerne om aktieselskaber findes i sels: The rules on limited liability companies are found in the Companies Act. The word limited company or the abbreviation A/S must be included in the company name. A limited company can have one or more owners. The owners of a limited company are called shareholders. In a limited liability company, the shareholders have limited liability for the company's debts. Limited liability means that Rikke is only liable with the company's equity. If she chooses this form of ownership, she only risks losing the capital she has invested in the company.
I et aktieselskab hæfter aktionærerne be: In a limited liability company, the shareholders have limited liability for the company's debts.
Den øverste myndighed i et aktieselskab: The highest authority in a limited company is the general meeting. The general meeting must be held at least once a year. The general meeting may possibly take place electronically. All shareholders have the right to attend the company's general meeting, where they have the right to vote. The general meeting elects a board of directors, which has the overall management of the company. The board of directors appoints a director or an executive who has day-to-day management. The company can, however, choose that both overall and day-to-day management be handled by the executive board. There is therefore no board. In return, a supervisory board must be elected to control the executive board.
Knap 8 % af de danske virksomheder havde: In 2022, just under 8% of Danish companies had the ownership form of a limited company. On the other hand, the limited companies have large companies when we measure the number of employees and turnover.
Ved stiftelse af et aktieselskab skal Ri: When establishing a limited company, Rikke must contribute equity. The contributed capital is also called share capital, and it must amount to at least DKK 400,000.
Hvis Rikke vælger aktieselskabsformen so: If Rikke chooses the limited company form of ownership, she will be the only shareholder. But she still has to hold a general meeting and elect a board.
Hun kan også lade andre personer indskyd: She can also let other people contribute capital to the company, and thus of course there will be more shareholders.

The necessary capital can be obtained through loans or by the owner injecting money into the company. The capital that the owner makes available to the company is called equity. You can also express it in the way that equity is the company's debt to the owner.
Hvor stor en egenkapital, virksomheden h: How much equity capital the company needs depends on, among other things of the industry and how much the bank and other funding sources will lend to the company.

Ejeren af en ny virksomhed har brug for: The owner of a new business needs to have a certain amount of capital. One speaks of a need for capital. Money must be used to buy, for example, furniture, cars and goods. Money must also be spent on furnishing business premises, and in connection with the establishment, for example, rent advances must be paid.
Der er grundlæggende to finansieringsfor: There are basically two forms of financing:
Virksomhedens ejer har forhåbentlig selv: The owner of the company has hopefully saved up some money himself, which can be invested in the business. This capital contribution is called equity. But the equity capital will usually not be enough to finance the company's total capital needs. It will therefore be necessary to borrow money. This is called debt capital or debt.
Egenkapital er den kapital, ejerne har s: Equity is the capital that the owners have made available to the company.
Den viser populært sagt virksomhedens gæ: Popularly speaking, it shows the company's debt to the owners.
Det vil sikkert være muligt at opnå en v: It will probably be possible to obtain some credit with the company's suppliers. If an supplier offers an credit of, for example, 3 months, the company must first pay the relevant supplier 3 months after receiving the goods. In the intervening time, the company hopefully sells a large part of the delivered goods and receives the money from the customer so that it can pay the supplier.

Målene med kapitel 2 er, at du kan:: The objectives of Chapter 2 are for you to be able to:
En virksomhed udfører i årets løb en ræk: A company carries out a number of activities during the year. This can be, for example, the purchase of goods, the sale of goods and the payment of rent. All activities must be documented with an attachment (e.g. a bill for rent). The appendices are registered in the company's bookkeeping, and when the year is over, an annual report can be drawn up.
Denne proces fremgår i figur 2.1 og beha: This process appears in Figure 2.1 and is dealt with in more detail in the following sections.
De økonomiske konsekvenser af handlinger: The financial consequences of the actions are recorded in the company's ERP system (Enterprise Resource Planning). An ERP system helps the company keep track of its activities and acts as a management tool. In day-to-day operations, it is useful to know what goods the company has on inventory, how much it owes to its suppliers, and how much goods have been sold for.
Efter en periode, fx en måned, er det in: After a period, e.g. a month, it is interesting for the company to do a follow-up. Did the company sell for the amount it expected? How large an amount is tied up in inventory? Does the company owe money to suppliers and can the company pay them? Can the company do anything to get receivables from customers home faster when credit has been given?
De fleste virksomheder laver et månedsre: Most companies prepare a monthly account, some just a quarterly account. It is easy to print a report from an ERP system. The reports provide an overview of how the month has progressed and what results the company has achieved. This can be compared with the same month's result last year and with the company's budget for the month.
Når året er gået udarbejdes et årsregnsk: When the year is over, an annual report is drawn up. In addition to the company itself and its owners, other stakeholders, such as the bank and suppliers, also want to know how the company is doing.
I dette kapitel ser vi nærmere på:: In this chapter we take a closer look at:
Virksomhedens økonomiske processer, fx i: The company's financial processes, e.g. purchase and sale of goods and time consumption, must be registered. It must be possible to follow the financial "traces" that each individual activity brings with it. For this purpose, the companies use an ERP system (Enterprise Resource Planning). An ERP system consists of various modules which are put together according to the company's needs.
En aktivitet udløser data, som vi i regn: An activity triggers data, which in accounting language we call an attachment. In some companies, a voucher is a piece of paper that is printed as proof that an activity has been completed. At most companies, vouchers are issued in digital form. Following the new bookkeeping act, many companies that submit an annual report must in future establish a digital bookkeeping system, where all appendices must be digitized. A document in paper form is no longer valid documentation for a transaction in the company.
Læs mere om digital bogføring i Virksomh: Read more about digital bookkeeping in the Business Guide: Digital bookkeeping – how to get ready.
Bilagene bliver registreret i virksomhed: The attachments are registered in the company's bookkeeping, which consists of a number of accounts (it's called an account - and accounts in the plural). Examples of accounts can be: Net turnover, Local costs and Payroll settlement.
I dag kan medarbejdere via elektroniske: Today, employees can register directly in the company's ERP system via electronic devices. This gives the advantage that activities are very quickly collected as data and can thus be used by the company as a management tool.
Når en kørende sælger har fået en ordre: When a traveling salesperson has received an order in a store, he enters the sale directly on an iPad or similar. As soon as the order is entered by the seller, the goods are reserved in the warehouse so that they are not sold to others, and preparations can be made to create an electronic bill (sales invoice) for the customer.
Et bilag, fx en salgsfaktura, skal godke: An attachment, e.g. a sales invoice, must be approved before it is final. This can be done by the company's sales manager approving the invoices before they are sent out. Once approval has taken place, the attachment can be finally registered in the ERP system. It is also called posting , which means that the activity is now included in the company's accounts .
Virksomheden kan udtrække forskellige re: The company can extract various accounting reports and analyzes from the ERP system. It can, for example, be an income statement. It shows the profit for a period.
Det kan også være en salgsrapport, der v: It can also be a sales report that shows how sales are distributed between customers or product groups.

Den digitale udvikling indenfor ERP-syst: The digital development within ERP systems has led to major changes in how companies register and use data.
Et integreret ERP-system danner hele tid: An integrated ERP system constantly generates new data that the company can use to manage daily operations. In this way, the ERP system is the "heart" of the company and becomes the governing body for all activities to function optimally.
Herunder er vist et eksempel på struktur: An example of the structure of a simple ERP system is shown below.
ERP-systemet sørger for, at virksomheden: The ERP system ensures that the company can always see how many items are on inventory. It also shows how much the company owes to its suppliers and vice versa owes to its customers.
Der er udviklet en række IT-hjælpeværktø: A number of IT support tools have been developed which can play together with the company's ERP system. This applies, for example, to cash register systems in a shop, which ensure that with each sale, the company's net turnover is increased by the actual sale. At the same time, the inventory is reduced in the inventory account and becomes a consumption of goods. For example, the ERP system e-conomic has developed the "Ajour cash register system", which automatically posts a sale directly to the correct accounts.
Der findes en række apps, som kan indgå: There are a number of apps that can be included in the daily registrations. An app can, for example, manage the time consumption of a lawyer or a craftsman, who can enter the daily consumption of hours on a mobile phone. In this way, the day's work can be immediately registered to the right customer, who will ultimately have to pay for the service.
Der kan også være tale om en app, hvor m: It can also be an app where you can take pictures of receipts if an employee is traveling and needs to document his expenses. When the picture of the receipt for a cup of coffee from the gas station is taken via the app, it is automatically registered in the company's ERP system.
Det er muligt at indscanne bilag direkte: It is possible to scan documents directly into the company's ERP system, which gives the company many advantages.

Rikke har opstillet en oversigt over, hv: Rikke has drawn up an overview of how Fashion Shoes' product consumption has been divided between summer shoes and winter shoes.
Forretningens vareforbrug er sammensat a: The business's consumption of goods is made up of sales (number of pairs of shoes sold), multiplied by the average cost price per sold pair of shoes.
Som det fremgik under opgørelse af netto: As was revealed during the calculation of net turnover, Rikke sells the most pairs of summer shoes.
Kostprisen på et par sommersko er gennem: The cost price of a pair of summer shoes is on average slightly lower than winter shoes.
Samlet set bliver vareforbruget lidt lav: Overall, the product consumption is slightly lower on summer shoes than on winter shoes.
Vareforbruget er kostprisen (anskaffelse: The consumption of goods is the cost price (acquisition price) of the goods the company has sold during a period.
The item consumption is a cost.
Kostprisen viser, hvad det har kostet vi: The cost price shows what it has cost the company to acquire the goods.
Kostpris = indkøbspris + hjemtagelsesomk: Cost price = purchase price + delivery costs, e.g. freight and packaging.
Bruttoavance er forskellen mellem nettoo: Gross profit is the difference between net sales and product consumption, i.e. what the company has earned from selling products.
Nu har Rikke opgjort både nettoomsætning: Rikke has now calculated both the net turnover and the product consumption of summer shoes and winter shoes. Now she is so interested to know how much she earns by selling the two types of shoes.

Out of a total gross profit of DKK 342,400, DKK 186,000 relates to the summer shoes and DKK 156,400 to the winter shoes.

Der tjenes altså mest på at sælge et par: The most profit is thus made by selling a pair of summer shoes.

Kan også defineres, som forskellen melle: Can also be defined as the difference between sales prices and cost prices for the goods the company has sold in a period.

Det er selvfølgelig positivt, når en han: It is of course positive when a trading company has a large turnover due to many customers in the store and sells goods for a large amount. However, a large turnover does not mean a large profit in the company.
I første omgang skal virksomheden kigge: In the first instance, the company must look at how much the goods sold have cost in acquisition price at the supplier. It is the difference between the selling and cost prices of the goods that helps to ensure that the company can achieve a gross profit on the sale of goods.

I eksemplet har virksomheden i år 1 haft: In the example, in year 1 the company had a net turnover of DKK 5,000,000, corresponding to the sale of goods. The goods sold cost DKK 3,000,000 to acquire. The gross profit in year 1 thus amounts to DKK 2,000,000.
En positiv bruttoavance opnås kun, hvis: A positive gross profit is only achieved if the net turnover amounts to a greater amount than the consumption of goods. This means that the company has sold the goods more expensively than they have bought them from the supplier. The greater the difference between selling prices and cost prices, the greater the gross profit.
Virksomheden opnår en negativ bruttoavan: The company achieves a negative gross profit if it fails to set the selling prices of the goods so that they are sold more expensively than they are purchased.

En resultatopgørelse viser virksomhedens: An income statement shows the company's ability to generate earnings, i.e. whether there is a profit or a deficit.
Resultatopgørelsen er opdelt i en venstr: The income statement is divided into a left and a right side. This form of arrangement is called account form. The left side shows the costs the company has had for a period of time. The right side shows the revenue the company has achieved over a period of time.
Indtægterne er først og fremmest salgsvæ: The income is primarily the sales value of the goods or services that the company has sold and delivered to its customers over a period of time.
Omkostningerne viser forbruget af produk: The costs show the consumption of means of production, e.g. goods, labor and services measured in DKK.

After this, an balance sheet is drawn up at the end of each financial year, i.e. per 31 December. The balance consists of assets and liabilities.
Aktiver er de værdier (beholdninger), so: assets are the values ​​(holdings) in which the company has placed (tied up) money. In other words, the asset side shows the company's investments (tied up money), e.g. inventory, cars and inventory.

I dette afsnit ser vi på årsregnskaber f: In this section we look at annual accounts for companies, i.e. limited liability companies (A/S) and limited liability companies (ApS).
Der er to hovedformål knyttet til regnsk: There are two main purposes linked to the preparation of the accounts. Firstly, the accounts is an important part of the company's internal reporting for use in the company's financial management. Secondly, the accounts is part of the external reporting to the company's stakeholders about the financial situation in the company. Through the annual accounts, stakeholders are informed about the company's earnings and liquidity.
Årsregnskabet viser først og fremmest no: The annual accounts primarily show something about the company's earnings. This earnings is decisive for how much the company owners can receive in dividends (profit sharing) and how much they can achieve in profit by selling their shares or shares.
Når man køber aktier (i et A/S) eller an: When you buy shares (in an A/S) or shares (in an ApS), you become a co-owner of the company. A share (or equity share) is thus equal to an ownership stake, and therefore one is interested in how the company's finances develop.
Virksomhedens långivere stiller krav om: The company's lenders demand to receive the company's annual accounts, where they can follow the company's financial development. The banks usually also require the budget for the coming year to be forwarded when they grant loans.
Leverandørerne kan ud fra årsregnskabet: Based on the annual accounts, the suppliers can assess the future opportunities for sales to the company, just as they can assess the company's ability to pay the debt on time.
Virksomhedens kunder er også interessere: The company's customers are also interested in the company's good earnings, and therefore also want to see the company's annual accounts. The customers also want to be able to buy goods or services from the company in the future in order to secure its supplies.
Medarbejderne , og deres faglige organis: The employees, and their trade unions, have a great interest in following the company's economic development. On the basis of the annual accounts, they can assess whether there are good prospects for employment and possible wage increases.
Offentlige myndigheder har behov for at: Public authorities need to obtain accounting information from the company. SKAT must, for example, use the annual accounts to check whether the company's VAT and tax payment is correct.
Hvis virksomheden drives som enkeltmands: If the company is run as a sole proprietorship or partnership, there is no requirement to publish the annual accounts. However, public authorities can always demand to be sent the company's accounts.
Det er et lovkrav , at aktieselskaber og: It is a legal requirement that limited liability companies and limited liability companies must publish their annual accounts. This is due, among other things, to limited liability in companies. As previously mentioned, shareholders and shareholders are only liable for their contributions. Companies must therefore submit their annual accounts to the Danish Business Authority, where the accounts are available to the public. It is possible to access these annual accounts via the internet, e.g. at virk.dk.

Målene med kapitel 3 er, at du kan:: The objectives of Chapter 3 are for you to be able to:
Budgettet er et vigtigt led i styringen: The budget is an important part of managing the company's finances. Where an accounts describes the financial results of the past, the budget describes the expected financial results of the future. You can therefore say that an budget is a kind of future accounting.
Ledelsen har en række planer for virksom: The management has a number of plans for the company's operation in the future. These can be, for example, plans for advertising campaigns and changes to sales prices. The budget shows whether these plans overall provide a satisfactory income (result) and liquidity.
Et budget viser forventningerne til virk: An budget shows the expectations for the company's finances for a future period.
Virksomhedens budgetter for en periode o: The company's budgets for a period includes:
I dette kapitel behandler vi kun bruttoa: In this chapter we only deal with the gross profit budget, the profit budget and the liquidity budget.
Vi gennemgår først bruttoavancebudgettet: We first review the gross profit budget, which includes the company's expected net revenue, product consumption, gross profit and gross profit percentage.
Bruttoavancebudgettet danner udgangspunk: The gross profit budget forms the basis for a profit budget, which includes the company's expected revenue and costs for the coming year. However, the company also needs to prepare a liquidity budget that shows the company's expected receipts and payments for the coming year.
Et af formålene med udarbejdelse af et b: One of the purposes of preparing an budget is that you can check whether the company lives up to its expectations. Such budget control, where the company compares budget figures with accounting figures, is also dealt with in the chapter.
Et bruttoavancebudget , der også kaldes: A gross profit budget, also called a sales budget, shows the company's expected gross profit in the coming period.
Det er vigtigt i god tid før budgetårets: It is important well in advance of the start of the budget year to calculate how much activity you expect to get in the budget year. The activity says something about how much you expect to sell. This of course has an impact on the store's expected earnings on the goods that are expected to be sold.
Et bruttoavancebudget kaldes også et sal: A gross profit budget is also called a sales budget. It shows the expected net turnover, the expected product consumption as well as the expected gross profit and gross profit percentage for a future period.

3.1.2 Kontrol af bruttoavancebudget: 3.1.2 Control of the gross profit budget
Som nævnt i forrige afsnit er det vigtig: As mentioned in the previous section, it is important, in good time, to calculate how much activity you expect to get in the budget year.
Planer og aktiviteter, der forventes gen: Plans and activities that are expected to be carried out in the coming period (budget year) must of course be in line with the company's overall idea. Plans that a company wants to carry out in the next financial year can be, for example, acquisition of new inventory, expansion of the product range, participation in trade fairs and employment of new employees.
Planerne og de forventede aktiviteter da: The plans and expected activities form the basis of the company's budget, which shows the expected financial consequences of the budget year.
I løbet af det nye regnskabsår omsættes: During the new financial year, the company's plans are translated into concrete actions in the form of, for example, the purchase of goods, the sale of goods and the consumption of goods. The actions are documented in the form of annexes, which are booked daily in the company's bookkeeping. It is thus the daily actions that form the basis for the accounts, which is prepared at the end of the financial year.
Regnskabet viser således de faktiske øko: the accounts thus shows the actual financial consequences of the actions carried out.
Et regnskab viser virksomhedens faktiske: An accounts shows the company's actual finances for a previous period.
Ved at sammenligne budgettet med regnska: By comparing the budget with the accounts, the company examines whether it went as expected. This comparison is called budget control. The result of the budget control forms the basis for a new budget for the next budget year.
Budgetkontrollen for et regnskabsår kan: The budget control for a financial year can cause the company to correct its plans. The new plans are incorporated into the budget for the following year.
En budgetkontrol er en sammenligning af: A budget check is a comparison of a period's accounts with the budget for the same period.

I dette afsnit vil vi gøre rede for begr: In this section, we will explain the terms expense, cost and payout, which are often used interchangeably in everyday speech. In business economics, however, these concepts each have a specific meaning.
Når en virksomhed anskaffer et produktio: When a company acquires a means of production, the cost price (acquisition price) for this will be an expense for the company.
En udgift opstår på det tidspunkt, hvor: An expense occurs when a company acquires a means of production.
Der er tale om en udgift , når en skobut: It is an expense when a shoe store buys goods for resale, when a brewery acquires a machine and when the owner of a hair salon contacts its accountant for tax advice.
Når en virksomhed forbruger et produktio: When a company consumes a means of production, an cost arises for the company.
En omkostning opstår på det tidspunkt, h: An cost occurs when a company consumes a means of production.

Der er altså tale om en omkostning , når: It is therefore an cost when the shoe store delivers goods to customers, when the brewery's purchased machine wears out and becomes obsolete, and when the accountant advises the owner of the hair salon.
Når en virksomhed betaler et produktions: When a company pays for a means of production, there is a payment for the company.
En udbetaling opstår på det tidspunkt, h: A payment occurs when a company pays for a means of production.
Ved kontantkøb falder udbetalingstidspun: For cash purchases, the time of payment coincides with the time of expenditure. In case of purchase on credit (deferred payment), the time of payment will be later than the time of expenditure.
Udbetalingsbegrebet drejer sig ikke alen: The concept of payment does not only refer to payment for acquired means of production. This is, for example, also a payment when a company pays installments on a loan, or when the owner of a company withdraws money from the fund for personal consumption.

Når en virksomhed har opbygget en kapaci: When a company has built up a capacity, it is possible for the company to create activities in the form of purchase, production and sale of goods and services.
Kapaciteten kræver, at virksomheden afho: The capacity requires the company to incur capacity costs. As mentioned, these costs are not directly determined by the size and composition of the market.
Aktivitet kræver også afholdelse af omko: Activity also requires holding costs, but the size of these costs is directly dependent on the size and composition of the market. This type costs is therefore called variable costs.
Herunder omtaler vi de vigtigste variabl: Below we discuss the most important variables costs.
I en handelsvirksomhed vil vareforbruget: In a trading business, commodity consumption will be one of the largest costs. A period's consumption of goods means the cost price (acquisition price) of the goods sold in the period. The cost price consists of the purchase price from the supplier with the addition of costs when the item is taken home, e.g. customs, freight and insurance premium.
I en produktionsvirksomhed udgør materia: In a manufacturing company, material consumption constitutes a significant cost . Material consumption includes consumed raw materials and components from sub-suppliers.
Da det totale vareforbrug eller material: Since the total product consumption or material consumption is directly determined by the sales or production size, these costs belong to the company's variable costs.
I de fleste virksomheder udgør lønninger: In most companies, salaries constitute one of the biggest costs . For certain service businesses, eg cleaning companies, law firms and medical practices, labor costs are the primary cost.
Vi vil i dette afsnit se lidt nærmere på: In this section, we will take a closer look at three groups of wage costs, namely wages, salesperson wages and other wages.
Ved arbejdsløn forstås den løn, som en p: Wage means the salary that a production company pays to the employees who are directly employed in the production of the company's products. However, wages can also occur in a service company, for example in the form of wages for the cleaning staff in a cleaning company.
Der findes principielt to forskellige må: There are basically two different ways of determining the salary. This is time pay if the employees are paid in proportion to the working time used. On the other hand, this is piecework pay if you are paid according to the amount of work performed. Salary, regardless of the form of remuneration, will as a general rule be a variable cost, as the total salary in the company will be directly determined by the size of the production.
Lønnen til salgspersonalet kan også fast: The salary for the sales staff can also be determined in two different ways, namely as a fixed salary per period or as an amount dependent on the seller's performance.
Får sælgeren en fast løn, vil denne som: If the seller receives a fixed salary, this will usually be paid once a month. The fixed salary will be a capacity cost, as the size of the salary is unaffected by the month's sales.
Hvis sælgeren aflønnes efter præsteret a: If the salesperson is remunerated based on the work performed, it is in the form of a sales commission. It is usually calculated as a certain percentage of the seller's turnover / sales. Sales commission is a variable cost , because the amount is directly determined by the sale.
De øvrige ansatte i virksomheden (admini: The other employees in the company (administrative employees etc.) will normally be paid a fixed salary per month, as the work performed is difficult to measure. The fixed salary will be a capacity cost, as it is not directly determined by the amount of sales.
For at gøre denne medarbejdergruppe inte: In order to make this group of employees interested in providing an efficient work effort, the company can supplement the fixed salary with a bonus, which can be calculated from the company's profit, for example.
De variable omkostninger vil naturligvis: The variables costs will naturally increase if the company increases its sales. However, the increase can have a different nature, and we therefore talk about:
De variable omkostninger stiger ofte i t: The variables costs often rise in line with increasing sales. This means that an increase in sales of, for example, 25% will cause the variables costs to increase by 25%. If so, the variables costs progress proportionally.
Når de variable omkostninger forløber pr: When the variables costs proceed proportionally, they change proportionally in step with the sales.
Ved definitionen af proportionale variab: In the definition of proportional variables costs, it is the total amount that changes in line with the size of the sale. If, on the other hand, the variables costs are calculated per unit sold, the amount will be the same, regardless of the size of the sale.
Når de variable omkostninger er proporti: In other words, when the variables costs are proportional, the variable unit costs will be a constant amount.

Det gælder ikke altid, at afsætningen og: It does not always apply that the sales and the variables costs change at the same rate. The variables costs can therefore easily have a progression that is not proportional.
Skobutikken Fashion Shoe skal ved et sti: The shoe store Fashion Shoe has to make larger purchases due to increasing sales, and the business will thus often be able to obtain a quantity discount (quantity discount) with its suppliers.
I en servicevirksomhed som fx et rengøri: In a service company such as a cleaning company, the workforce will often be poorly utilized if there is very little activity. Only with increasing activity can the benefits of the division of labor and specialization be exploited. In the cleaning company, this can be achieved, for example, by one employee only cleaning floors, another taking care of window cleaning, a third dusting, etc.
I en produktionsvirksomhed kan en øget p: In a manufacturing company, increased production can also result in better utilization of the workforce.
Opnåelse af kvantumsrabatter og en øget: Achieving quantity discounts and increased specialization means that the variables costs increase less than proportionally with sales. This means that the variables costs proceed degressively.
Når de variable omkostninger forløber de: When the variables costs progress degressively, they change proportionally less than the sales.
I tabel 4.2 ses et eksempel på degressiv: Table 4.2 shows an example of degressive variables costs.
Når den månedlige afsætning stiger fra f: When the monthly sales increase from, for example, 2,000 pcs. to 3,000 pieces, i.e. by 50%, then the variable costs (VO) only increases by 20%, namely from DKK 100,000 to DKK 120,000. The degressive course means that the variable unit costs (VE) fall with increasing sales.
Herefter vises grafer for degressive var: Graphs are then shown for degressive variables costs in total and variable unit costs based on the amounts from table 4.2.
Ved det degressive forløb er grafen for: In the degressive process, the graph for the variables costs in total (VO) is increasing, but the increase is decreasing with a larger sale. The graph of the variable unit costs (VE) shows a decrease as sales expand.
Det kan også forekomme, at de variable o: It can also happen that the variables costs increase more than proportionally with the size of the sale. In the case of a large activity, a large waste of materials can occur due to busyness.
I en produktionsvirksomhed kan der fx væ: In a production company, for example, an increase in production may result in overtime or shift work. Overtime or shift allowance must then be paid to the employees. Labor costs thus increase more than proportionally with sales.
I en virksomhed vil det ofte være sådan,: In a company, it will often be the case that premises and the physical framework are only designed for a certain level of activity. This can also be the case with machines. If the activity increases beyond this, space problems will simply arise, so that employees get in each other's way. This can cause the variables costs to increase more than proportionally to the activity.
I en handelsvirksomhed kan det i periode: In a trading company, during periods of high sales activity, it can happen that you run out of a product type and therefore have to order urgent orders home from the supplier. This will typically result in increasing order costs, including handling and shipping fees.
I de nævnte tilfælde forløber de variabl: In the cases mentioned, the variables costs proceed progressively.
Når de variable omkostninger forløber pr: When the variables costs progress progressively, they change proportionally more than the sales.
I tabel 4.3 vises et eksempel på progres: Table 4.3 shows an example of progressive variables costs.
Når den månedlige afsætning stiger fra f: When the monthly sales increase from, for example, 2,000 pcs. to 3,000 pieces, i.e. by 50%, then the variable costs (VO) increases by no less than 71%, namely from DKK 140,000 to DKK 240,000. The progressive course means that the variable unit costs (VE) increase with a larger sale.
Herefter vises grafer for progressive va: Graphs are then shown for progressive variables costs in total and variable unit costs based on the amounts from table 4.3.
Ved det progressive forløb er grafen for: In the progressive course, the graph for the variables costs in total (VO) is increasing, but the increase is increasing with a larger sale. The graph of the variable unit costs (VE) shows an increase as sales expand.
Gennemgangen af variable omkostninger ha: The review of variables costs has shown that there is the following relationship between the course of variables costs in total and the variable unit costs:
Når VO forløber proportionalt, er VE kon: When VO proceeds proportionally, VE is constant with increased activity.
Når VO forløber degressivt, er VE falden: When VO proceeds degressively, VE is decreasing with increased activity.
Når VO forløber progressivt, er VE stige: When VO is progressive, VE is increasing with increased activity.
I praksis er det naturligvis ikke sådan,: In practice, of course, it is not the case that the variables costs always either increase degressively, proportionally or progressively. Studies show, on the contrary, that the course of the variables costs is typically degressive with a relatively small activity, proportional with a medium activity and progressive with a relatively large activity.

En virksomhed kan ved aflønning af sine: When remunerating its employees, a company can choose to use different forms of remuneration:
Ved tidløn får medarbejderen en fast tim: With hourly wages, the employee receives a fixed hourly wage or monthly wage.
Ved præstationsløn får medarbejderne en: With performance pay, employees receive a salary that depends solely on their production or sales.
Ved en kombination af tidløn og præstati: With a combination of hourly wages and performance wages, the employee is paid both a fixed hourly wage and, in addition, a piece rate or commission wage that depends on the employee's production or sales.
En produktionsvirksomhed vil ved aflønni: A production company will use hourly wages when paying employees in production if it places more emphasis on the quality of the work than on the quantity of finished goods produced.
En virksomheds administrative medarbejde: A company's administrative employees almost always receive a fixed monthly salary, as it is very difficult to measure the employees' work performance.
Tidløn er i mange tilfælde en kapacitets: Time pay is in many cases a capacity cost (fixed cost ).
I en produktionsvirksomhed, som fx et sl: In a production company, such as a slaughterhouse or a furniture factory, the employees in the production are often paid a piece rate, which is a form of performance pay. Here, the employee's salary and the company's labor costs are directly determined by the size of the production. If the employees work in teams, the team's total production will form the basis of a collective agreement.
Virksomheden kan selvfølgelig også anven: The company can, of course, also use a combination of time pay and performance pay, so that the employees partly get a fixed salary, but at the same time are motivated to make an extra effort with an agreement that is dependent on production.
Salgspersonalet bliver måske aflønnet me: The sales staff may be remunerated with sales commissions. The size of the sales commission for a salesperson is determined by how much that person has sold during the period. This form of remuneration is mainly used in wholesale trade.
Præstationsløn er en variabel omkostning: Performance pay is a variable cost.

Skoene forhandles af en grossist i Vejle: The shoes are sold by a wholesaler in Vejle. Rikke contacts the wholesaler and a carrier to get the information she needs as a basis for preparing a contribution calculation.
Da bidragskalkulationen skal udarbejdes,: Since the contribution calculation must be prepared before Rikke buys the shoes, this is a preliminary calculation. The calculation thus shows the expected variables costs by purchasing and selling the 45 pairs of shoes.
Hjemtagelsesomkostninger er de omkostnin: Repatriation costs are the costs Fashion Shoe must pay from the time the goods are shipped from the supplier until they are at the company's inventory. A freight company in Horsens has offered to arrange the freight for DKK 450 without VAT.
Hjemtagelsesomkostningerne lægges nu til: The repatriation costs are now added to the invoice amount, as these costs make the goods more expensive. Rikke now knows the cost price, which shows how much the goods will cost in total when they arrive at the company's warehouse.
Fashion Shoe skal nu pakke skoene pænt i: Fashion Shoe must now wrap the shoes neatly as Christmas presents, and the company must deliver the shoes to the Auditor's Office. Rikke expects that the costs for sales packaging and sales freight will amount to DKK 600 without VAT. These costs are collectively called variable selling costs.
Variable salgsomkostninger skal herefter: Variable selling costs must then be added to the cost price, as they make the goods more expensive. Rikke now knows the total variables costs for the 45 pairs of shoes. It has been calculated at DKK 39,325.50.
Til slut kan Rikke beregne de variable e: Finally, Rikke can calculate the variable unit costs for 1 pair of shoes, model Modena.

Som det fremgår af gennemgangen, skal bi: As can be seen from the review, contribution calculations must not include VAT. However, Fashion Shoe must pay VAT on the goods, freight and sales packaging. Fashion Shoe registers this VAT on account for purchase VAT, and it is reimbursed (refunded) in connection with the VAT settlement. The purchase VAT must therefore not be included in a calculation, as it is not an cost for the company.

Hjemtagelsesomkostninger kan omfatte fra: Repatriation costs may include freight, insurance premium, goods tax as well as freight forwarding and customs.
Når der indgås en handel, aftaler køber: When a transaction is concluded, the buyer and seller agree on a delivery condition.
Når køberen skal betale fragten, skal de: When the buyer has to pay the freight, it must be included in the item's cost price. In the example, the delivery condition is ex factory. The freight from Portugal to Ballerup must therefore be included in the calculation.
Det er normalt, at varerne forsikres und: It is normal for the goods to be insured during transport. The goods will thus be replaced if they break during transport. The following applies to payment of the insurance premium:
Når køberen skal betale forsikringspræmi: When the buyer must pay the insurance premium, this must be included when calculating the cost price of the goods. This is the case in this example, as it has been agreed ex factory.
Forsikringspræmien beregnes som en proce: The insurance premium is calculated as a percentage (%) or a per thousand rate (‰) of the sum insured. The sum insured is often calculated as the invoice amount, but in some cases the freight can be included in the calculation of the sum insured. In the example, the sum insured is the invoice amount + the freight to Denmark. In this case, the insurance premium is 1% of the insurance amount, and it is calculated as follows:
Forsikringssummens størrelse og måden, d: The size of the sum insured and the way it is calculated can be agreed from time to time. In the example, the insurance sum includes the invoice amount and shipping to Denmark.
Et speditionsfirma er en servicevirksomh: A forwarding company is a service company that helps with the transport of goods and the associated paperwork. Forwarding companies are also called freight forwarders, carriers, freight companies or shipping companies. They can, for example, help fill in waybills, import permits and customs documents. They can also contact the foreign supplier and agree a precise time for the collection of the goods.
Disse serviceydelser koster naturligvis: Of course, these services cost money. In the example, it has been sold ex factory, and therefore Rikke includes the listed forwarding costs in the calculation. Notice once again that it is the amount without VAT that must be included in the calculation.
Når Fashion Shoe importerer varer fra et: When Fashion Shoe imports goods from a country outside the EU, the store generally has to pay import duties. In the example, the goods are imported from Portugal, which is a member of the EU, and therefore Rikke does not calculate with any import duties.
Variable omkostninger kan omfatte salgsp: Variable costs can include sales commission, sales packaging, sales freight and surcharge. In the example, only the sales commission and sales packaging are included.
Hvis Rikke ved salg af et par sko fx giv: If, for example, Rikke gives the customer a free shoe polish when selling a pair of shoes, this is a surcharge. Such an allowance must be included when preparing a calculation for the shoes in question.
Ved at lægge de variable salgsomkostning: By adding the variable selling costs together with the cost price, Rikke arrives at the total variables costs.
Til slut opgøres de variable enhedsomkos: Finally, the variable unit costs are calculated as shown by dividing the total variables costs by the number of pairs of shoes purchased.

Afsnit 4.8 og 4.9 omhandlede bidragskalk: Sections 4.8 and 4.9 dealt with contribution calculations in trading companies. Contribution calculations include the product's variables costs, e.g. product consumption and take-home costs.
Produktionsvirksomheder udarbejder også: Manufacturing companies also prepare contribution calculations over an item's variable costs . Here we are talking about the purchase of various raw materials and components that are processed into finished products that are sold to customers.
Footwear A/S: Kalkulation i produktionsv: Footwear A/S: Calculation in production business
Skofabrikken Footwear A/S har modtaget e: Skofabrikken Footwear A/S has received an inquiry from a large Danish retail chain. The request is for 1,000 pairs of shoes, model Modena. Since the prices of the raw materials are very fluctuating, Footwear wants to prepare a contribution calculation before the offer is sent to the customer.
Da bidragskalkulationen udarbejdes, før: Since the contribution calculation is prepared before the shoes are produced, it is a preliminary calculation. The calculation thus shows the expected variables costs by producing and selling the 1,000 pairs of shoes.
Det fremgår, at de variable produktionso: It appears that the variable production costs amount to DKK 258,033.
Det fremgår, at de variable salgsomkostn: It appears that the variable selling costs total DKK 6,000.
De variable omkostninger (VO) består af: The variable costs (VO) consists of the variable production costs DKK 258,033 and the variable sales costs DKK 6,000. VO therefore amounts to DKK 264,033.
Til slut beregner Footwear de variable e: Finally, Footwear calculates the variable unit costs for 1 pair of shoes, model Modena.
Footwear kender nu de variable enhedsomk: Footwear now knows the variable unit costs (VE) for the Modena shoe model. According to the contribution calculation, they amount to DKK 264.03.
Footwear vil selvfølgelig ikke videresæl: Of course, Footwear will not resell the shoes at this price. They also have fixed costs that must be covered, e.g. rent, wages and other costs . There should also be a profit when the year is over. Before the selling price can be found, Footwear therefore calculates with an contribution margin. The contribution must help to cover the fixed costs (capacity costs) and the store's profits. For the Modena model, the coverage contribution amounts to 32% of the variable unit costs. Footwear has found this percentage in collaboration with its accountant.
Footwear kan nu opstille en priskalkulat: Footwear can now set up a price calculation, where they calculate the selling price for 1 pair of shoes, model Modena.
Footwear kan nu skrive tilbuddet til kun: Footwear can now write the offer to the customer.
Revisorkontoret accepterer tilbuddet fra: The auditor's office accepts the offer from Fashion Shoe. The shoes have now been delivered, and Rikke has received invoices from the wholesaler in Vejle, the shipper in Horsens and Kontorforsyningen A/S, who supplied the packaging materials.
Rikke kan nu opstille en bidragskalkulat: Rikke can now set up a contribution calculation prepared as a post-calculation. The calculation shows the trade's actual costs.
Ved at sammenligneforkalkulationenmed de: By comparing the pre-calculation with this post-calculation, Rikke notices that it did not go quite as expected.
De variable enhedsomkostninger var budge: The variable unit costs were budgeted at DKK 873.90, but they actually only amounted to DKK 866.83.
Selv om det gik bedre end forventet, gen: Even though it went better than expected, Rikke still went through the calculation line by line as shown to find possible reasons for the deviations. In this way, she will be better able to calculate in the future.
Som vist ovenfor er det et stort arbejde: As shown above, calculating a selling price is a lot of work. This is especially the case if the company makes many offers or if it often changes the product range.

Begrebet logistik, der stammer fra milit: The term logistics, which originates from the military, covers the delivery of materiel in the form of e.g. vehicles, fuel, weapons and ammunition as well as the accommodation of soldiers with associated supplies of food, water, etc. Whether a war is won or lost has always been influenced by whether the supplies have arrived in the right quality, in the right quantity, at the right time and in the right place.
På samme måde er det vigtigt for en virk: In the same way, it is important for a company's success that it can deliver goods to its customers in the right quality, in the right quantity, at the right time and in the right place.
Logistik kan defineres sådan:: logistics can be defined like this:
Logistik er styringen af virksomhedens v: logistics is the management of the company's product flows from a holistic view.
Logistik er et styringssystem, der skal: logistics is a management system that must ensure planning, implementation and control of an efficient flow of goods from the suppliers through the company and out to the customers. The purpose is to satisfy customers' needs.
Logistik er i dag en vigtig konkurrencep: logistics is today an important competitive parameter. There are several reasons for this. First, the selling price plays a decisive role for customers. In order to keep the price down, the company must keep track of the costs in connection with the flow of goods. Secondly, the company must be better than its competitors in delivering the goods to customers in the right quality, in the right quantity, at the right time and in the right place.

Engrosvirksomheders kunder er andre virk: The customers of wholesale companies are other companies, while the customers of retail companies are the final consumer. From an overall view, it is not effective, for example, that the purchasing department is good at buying goods home at a good price if the goods cannot be sold by the sales department. In the same way, it is also not efficient for the purchasing department to purchase goods in large batches in order to obtain a quantity discount, if the goods then have to sit for a very long time on inventory before they are sold.

Efterhånden, som en virksomhed vokser, ø: As a company grows, the need to distribute work tasks between different departments increases. Such specialization is often a prerequisite for obtaining economic efficiency. In section 5.3.1 we therefore look at the classic principles for division of labor between the company's departments.
En virksomhed kan også prøve at forbedre: A company can also try to improve its financial efficiency by handing over (outsourcing) work tasks to another company. An alternative could be to outsource the transport function to an external haulier who might be able to handle the task both better and cheaper. Such outsourcing is called outsourcing, which is explained in more detail in section 5.3.2.
Store virksomheder opretter ofte en særs: Large companies often set up a separate logistics department to ensure that the other departments "play together". Small and medium-sized companies may employ a single employee who is responsible for logistics. In small companies, it is not usually necessary to have a separate logistics function. The location of the logistics function in the organization is dealt with in section 5.3.3.
Som forklaret iafsnit 2.1er aktivitetern: As explained in section 2.1, the activities in the sales, purchasing and warehouse department are economic processes that trigger data (appendices) that are registered in the company's ERP system. Myndighederne stiller også krav til virk: The authorities also require the company to provide written documentation in the form of appendices for a transaction. This can be, for example, invoices and credit notes.
Når en virksomhed vokser i størrelse, bl: When a company grows in size, more employees are needed. When there are many employees in a company, the tasks must be distributed among the employees. This division of labor must ensure that the goods are managed through the company in the most reasonable, cost-saving and fastest way.
Ved arbejdsdelingen skal det fastlægges,: In the division of labor, it must be determined how the tasks are to be distributed between the company's departments.
Vi vil se på to forskellige principper f: We will look at two different principles of division of labour, namely:
Funktionsprincippet er meget anvendt ved: The functional principle is widely used in the division of labor in Danish companies. A function is a number of work tasks that belong together, e.g. sales or purchasing.
Ved funktionsprincippet forstås en forde: The functional principle means a distribution of work tasks according to functions.

En bilforhandler kan også anvende funkti: A car dealer can also use the functional principle. Examples of functions could be workshop and preparation. Each function then takes care of all the car dealer's product groups: Private cars, company cars and spare parts.
Ved funktionsprincippet fordeles alle ar: With the function principle, all work tasks that naturally belong together are distributed to different functions (departments).
Objektprincippet bruges især, når virkso: The object principle is used in particular when the company's range consists of very different goods or there are very different groups of customers. An object can be, for example, a product, a product group, a customer group or a geographical area.
Ved objektprincippet forstås en fordelin: The object principle means a distribution of work tasks according to objects. The object principle means that a specific department performs all tasks for a specific product group, customer group or a geographical area.

Ved arbejdsdeling mellem afdelinger kan: When dividing work between departments, you can also combine the functional and object principles.
Ved objektprincippet fordeles alle arbej: With the object principle, all work tasks for one object (a product group, customer group or a geographical area) are distributed to one department.
En virksomhed bør under normale omstændi: Under normal circumstances, a company should concentrate on what it does best, i.e. its so-called core competencies.
En handelsvirksomheds kernekompetencer e: A trading company's core competencies are typically supplier search, purchasing, marketing, customer service and sales.
Andre af virksomhedens funktioner kan no: Other functions of the company can sometimes be advantageously left to other companies that possess greater expertise than the company itself. Examples of such peripheral tasks are cleaning, IT and canteen operations, reception and telephone switching, inventory/packing, transport and bookkeeping.
De varer/serviceydelser, virksomheden ik: The goods/services that the company does not want to manufacture themselves must be purchased from suppliers, who has the necessary expertise. In this connection, one talks about the tasks being outsourced or contracted out.

En væsentlig fordel ved outsourcing er o: A significant advantage of outsourcing is often that the company's capacity costs are reduced, but on the other hand the company's variables costs are increased. The overall calculation will usually show that the company gets fewer total costs at the same time that it becomes more flexible in the event of a decline in activity. In the short term, the company can free itself more easily from variable costs than from capacity costs.
En ulempe ved outsourcing er, at virksom: A disadvantage of outsourcing is that the company becomes more dependent on its suppliers. This is especially true if the company outsources more pronounced core tasks, or if it only has a very limited number of supplierss to choose from.
En virksomhed kan komme til den erkendel: A company may come to the realization that it was not a wise decision to outsource a task to another company. It can therefore decide to withdraw the task. In that case, it is insourcing. There can be several reasons why a task is outsourced. The problem with the previous outsourcing could be, for example, that the expected savings did not hold up, that the quality was not satisfactory, or that problems arose with the company's security of supply.
Make or buy er spørgsmålet om, hvorvidt: Make or buy is the question of whether a company will manufacture a product/service itself or outsource it to an external supplier.
Outsourcing er, når en virksomhed køber: Outsourcing is when a company buys activities it previously performed itself from external suppliers.
En virksomheds kernekompetencer er de om: A company's core competencies are the areas in which it stands strong in relation to its competitors, and which are of great importance to the company's competitiveness.
Aktiviteter, der kræver udnyttelse af vi: As a general rule, activities that require utilization of the company's core competencies should not be outsourced.
Perifere opgaver er aktiviteter, der ikk: Peripheral tasks are activities that do not require the utilization of the company's core competencies. Peripheral tasks can often be advantageously outsourced.
Insourcing er, når en virksomhed trækker: Insourcing is when a company withdraws a task that was previously outsourced.

5.3.3 Logistikfunktionens placering i vi: 5.3.3 Location of the logistics function in the company
En handelsvirksomheds logistikfunktion s: As mentioned, a trading company's logistics function must coordinate the interaction between the company's sales, purchasing and warehouse departments. As one extreme, the company can set up an independent logistics department, or as the other extreme, choose to let the various departments collaborate on logistics tasks without an independent logistics department.
Hvis logistikaktiviteterne er meget omfa: If the logistics activities are very extensive, the company can choose to centralize the logistics management in an independent logistics department.
Logistikafdelingen koordinerer indkøb, l: The logistics department coordinates purchasing, inventory and distribution. The sales department is still responsible for the marketing and sales of the company's products, but the actual distribution of the products is handled by the logistics department. The figure also shows that the company has an independent finance and IT department.
Fordelen ved at have en central logistik: The advantage of having a central logistics department is first and foremost that it provides a comprehensive overview of all - or most - logistics activities. This applies to both the external activities with goods in and out of the company and the internal activities in the company (e.g. unpacking and checking of goods, stock count and internal orders). In other words, it becomes easier to control the flow of goods.
Ulempen ved en central logistikafdeling: The disadvantage of a central logistics department is that conflicts can arise between the logistics department on the one hand and the sales department on the other. This is usually because parts of the sales department's traditional areas of responsibility have been transferred to the logistics department.
Som det ene yderpunkt kan virksomheden o: As one extreme, the company can set up an independent logistics department, or as the other extreme, you can choose to have the various departments collaborate on logistics tasks without an independent logistics department.
I mindre virksomheder vil logistikfunkti: In smaller companies, the logistics function will not normally be visible in the company's organizational chart. Purchasing, inventory sales and finance coordinate their activities through regular business processes where sales orders become purchase orders as shown in Figure 5.2 on the logistics process.
Den største fordel ved at en decentral l: The biggest advantage of a decentralized logistics function is that the company achieves a high degree of flexibility. You can decide on a solution more quickly when a problem arises.
Ulempen ved en decentralisering af logis: The disadvantage of decentralizing the logistics function is that conflicts can arise between the departments. In some situations, it can be difficult to ensure a holistic view of the solution of the tasks, as each department will be inclined to look after its own interests at the expense of the overall interests of the company.
Beslutningen om en central eller decentr: The decision about a central or decentralized logistics function should be made according to what all in all gives the greatest possible profit. In other words, the company's overall financial efficiency must be taken into account.
Når ansvaret for logistikopgavernes udfø: When responsibility for the execution of logistics tasks is placed in an independent logistics department, the company uses a centralization of logistics tasks.
Når de forskellige afdelinger samarbejde: When the various departments collaborate on logistics tasks without an independent logistics department, the company uses a decentralization of logistics tasks.

Kvaliteten af virksomhedens logistik har: The quality of the company's logistics has a great impact on the company's financial efficiency. An example of a logistical challenge for many online stores is getting the inventory and sales function to keep up. En virksomhed vil som udgangspunkt selvf: As a starting point, a company naturally wants to meet all the customers' expectations for both low prices, fast delivery and good service. Maybe 85% of a company's customers are already satisfied, but what about the last 15%?
Alle tre alternativer vil alt andet lige: All three alternatives will, other things being equal, improve the company's delivery service. But before a decision is made, it is necessary to investigate which logistics costs the decision entails.
I dette afsnit ser vi nærmere på virksom: In this section, we take a closer look at the company's logistics costs and delivery service. The concepts are important to understand in order to analyze and assess how the company's logistics can be improved.

En virksomheds logistikomkostninger kan: A company's logistics costs can be divided into the following main items:
En virksomheds leveringsservice har stor: A company's delivery service has a great influence on the company's consumption of logistics costs. A high delivery service will generally lead to high logistics costs.
Lageromkostninger omfatter de omkostning: Inventory costs include those costs , associated with having an inventory. This primarily concerns interest on the capital tied up in the warehouse. After all, the goods on the company's inventory have been purchased and mostly paid for. The money to pay for the goods is obtained either by borrowing from, for example, the bank or by withdrawing liquid funds from the bank. If the money has been obtained through a loan, interest must be paid to the bank. If the money has been obtained by withdrawing liquid funds from the bank, this results in a loss of interest income.
Desuden er der omkostninger til selve dr: In addition, there is costs for the actual operation of the warehouse, i.e. rent, electricity, heat and wages. Finally, it can be costs in the form of shrinkage, i.e. goods that have lost value due to obsolescence or because they have been damaged.
De nævnte omkostninger registreres ikke: The mentioned costs are not recorded as inventory costs in the accounts. In the separate income statement, they are included under other external costs, personnel costs, depreciation and interest costs. It can therefore be difficult in practice to calculate the size of these costs.
Der vil være forskel på, hvor hårdt en v: There will be a difference in how hard a company is hit by storage costs. For example, the storage costs for a company with a positive cash balance will be relatively low. The money for the purchase of inventory has been withdrawn from a deposit account with a low interest rate. The interest loss is therefore relatively small. In a different way, a company where the money for the inventory has been obtained by drawing on the overdraft, where the interest rate is much higher, is hit hard.
Fashion Shoe har et lager af sko i butik: Fashion Shoe has an inventory of shoes in the store and a smaller room with extra sizes. The shoes have been paid for by Rikke withdrawing the money from the overdraft, where she pays 10% interest p.a. In addition, Rikke of course pays rent, electricity and heat for the warehouse. There are no actual warehouse staff employed.
Emballage- og pakkeomkostninger omfatter: Packaging and packaging costs include costs for packaging materials, packaging machines and wages. These costs will not normally be immediately visible in the accounts either, since in the classified income statement they will be included under other external costs, personnel costs and depreciation.

I Fashion Shoe er emballage- og pakkeomk: In Fashion Shoe, packaging and packaging costs are limited.
Forretningen har nogle plastikposer, som: The store has some plastic bags that the customers receive the shoes in. There is also costs for gift wrap and packaging for return goods.
Transportomkostninger består af både int: Transport costs consist of both internal transport costs between the individual departments in the company and external transport costs of goods from suppliers and to customers.
Hvis virksomheden selv udfører transport: If the company carries out the transport itself, or if external hauliers carry out the transport on behalf of the company, it will normally be relatively easy to calculate these costs .
Hvis omkostningerne for en varetransport: If, on the other hand, the costs for a goods transport from an supplier are included in the supplier's price for the goods, they will appear in the company's accounts as part of the goods consumption in the type-divided income statement.
