Delivery service is aimed at customers. If the company provides a good delivery service, this can help create a bigger sale and thus revenue for the company. Service is an important competitive parameter for companies. Within logistics, particular emphasis is placed on service during the sale, and therefore the term delivery service is used.
Leveringsservice kan opdeles på følgende: Delivery service can be divided as follows:
Leveringstiden er den tid, der går, fra: The delivery time is the time that elapses from the time the company receives the order until the goods are at the delivery location agreed with the customer. The delivery time includes i.a. the time spent on administrative processing of the order. If the company does not have the ordered goods on inventory, these must first be ordered home from the supplier. The delivery time from the supplier is therefore also included in the total delivery time. Finally, the delivery time also includes the time used for packing and distributing the goods.
Den øgede brug af IT i virksomhederne er: The increased use of IT in companies is helping to shorten the delivery time. IT can be used, for example, to exchange information about stock levels and the time of dispatch of the goods. The actual ordering of the item is also often done electronically.
Fashion Shoe er en detailvirksomhed. Her: Fashion Shoe is a retail business. Here, customers come into the store and buy shoes. Normally the shoes will be on inventory and they can be delivered immediately. There will therefore be no delivery time.
Det kan dog forekomme, at skoene er udso: However, it may happen that the shoes are sold out and must be ordered home from the supplier, e.g. Footwear. The delivery time will then depend on how long the delivery time is from Footwear.
Lagerservicegraden er et udtryk for, hvo: The warehouse service level is an expression of how large a proportion of the incoming orders can be delivered directly from the company's finished goods warehouse. A warehouse service level of 80% therefore shows that the company is able to dispatch 80% of all received orders directly from the warehouse.
De sidste 20 % af de modtagne ordrer er: The last 20% of the orders received are in so-called backorder.
I Fashion Shoe er lagerservicegraden ret: In Fashion Shoe, the warehouse service level is quite high. Normally, the customer wants to buy a pair of shoes that are in the store, and the customer can therefore get the product immediately.
Nogle gange kan den størrelse, som kunde: Sometimes the size that the customer wants may be out of stock. Fashion Shoe will then have to re-order the item from e.g. Footwear.
Leveringsoverholdelse kaldes også for le: Delivery compliance is also called delivery precision. Both expressions cover how good the company is at complying with the agreement entered into with the customer.
Forsinkelser fra sælgers side kan hos ku: Delays on the part of the seller can lead to delays in the customer's deliveries to its customers. In the worst case, it can lead to claims for compensation, cancellation of concluded contracts and bad reputation. Compliance with the delivery time is often more important to the customer than a short delivery time. The company's customers are also usually not interested in the goods arriving too early. They may not have available storage space, or the employees may not have time to receive the goods.
Hvis kunden er en anden virksomhed, kan: If the customer is another company, this may have several departments and thus several different addresses. It is therefore important that the delivery takes place to the correct address and not just to a random one of the company's addresses.
Det er også vigtigt, at varerne leveres: It is also important that the goods are delivered to the customer in the agreed quantity and in the agreed quality. A failure here may result in the customer not being able to comply with agreements entered into with its customers.
I de fleste tilfælde vil Fashion Shoe ha: In most cases, Fashion Shoe will have a very good delivery compliance. After all, the customer gets the item home from the store, and it is therefore of course delivered at the right time, in the right quantity, in the right place and in the right quality.
Der kan dog opstå problemer, hvis der er: However, problems can arise if the item is sold out and therefore must be ordered from the supplier. Here, delivery compliance will depend on whether Fahion Shoe receives the shoes on time from the supplier.
Leveringsfleksibilitet er et spørgsmål o: Delivery flexibility is a question of the company's ability to cope with unforeseen changes regarding the delivery. It may be that the customer wants a larger quantity than originally agreed, faster delivery or changes to the variants and qualities originally ordered.
Inden for tøjbranchen sker det tit, at t: In the clothing industry, it often happens that clothing stores want additional deliveries of goods at short notice if the current clothing fashion proves to be popular. Accommodating rush orders can therefore be an important competitive parameter in this industry.
Leveringsfleksibilitet er normalt ikke n: Delivery flexibility is usually not a particularly important factor for Fashion Shoes customers. For Fashion Shoe, on the other hand, it is very important that their supplier has good delivery flexibility.
Det vil jo fx betyde, at Fashion Shoe hu: This will mean, for example, that Fashion Shoe can quickly get extra shoes delivered if a model proves to be very popular with customers.
Leveringsinformation i rette tid kan vær: Delivery information at the right time can help to provide good cooperation with the customer. A company should inform its customers as soon as it discovers that it is not possible to comply with an agreement entered into. After all, customers must also be able to notify their customers about delays or back orders. In the case of larger deliveries, the company should inform the customers of what time of day the delivery will arrive, so that staff are present to receive the goods.
Mange kunder har i dag direkte elektroni: Many customers today have direct electronic access to the suppliers' data on stocks and delivery times. Customers can also follow how far their orders have come with the suppliers.
Hos Fashion Shoe er det kun nødvendigt m: At Fashion Shoe, delivery information is only necessary in cases where the company has ordered some shoes for a customer.
Fashion Shoe kan tilbyde kunden at ringe: Fashion Shoe can offer the customer to call when the shoes have arrived or if there are delays.

Some companies find the best combination in a very high level of service and thus also in quite high logistics costs. Other companies are successful with a low level of service and very low logistics costs.
Virksomheden kan arbejde systematisk med: The company can work systematically to improve logistical efficiency and thereby strengthen its competitiveness.
Begrebet leveringsservice kan ikke opgør: The concept of delivery service cannot be calculated as a concrete figure. Therefore, one cannot accurately calculate the logistic efficiency. Det er vigtigt, at en virksomhed styrer: It is important that a company manages the warehouse. Inventory management is an important part of logistics management, as it must ensure that the company has enough goods at inventory at all times. It is a matter of providing a good delivery service.
Et stort lager gør virksomheden mindre s: A large inventory makes the company less vulnerable to supplier failure and seasonal fluctuations in sales. On the other hand, there are storage costs associated with maintaining an inventory, so the company must balance delivery service against storage costs.

Fordelen ved at have et varelager er, at: The advantage of having a warehouse is that the company can achieve a better delivery service and thus a higher logistical efficiency. On the other hand, large inventories entail additional storage costs and thus logistics costs. This contributes to the deterioration of logistical efficiency. The company must therefore balance the size of the inventory with the desired delivery service in relation to the storage costs.
Størrelsen af en virksomheds varelager p: However, the size of a company's inventory is also affected by other factors. Part of the inventory may have arisen, for example, from the fact that the actual sales in a period have been less than the planned sales for the period.
En virksomhed kan have flere grunde til: A business may have several reasons for maintaining inventory. Motives for having a relatively large inventory may include a desire to:
Hovedmotivet vil som nævnt ofte være, at: As mentioned, the main motive will often be that inventories contribute to the company being able to provide a good delivery service. With a large inventory, the company can more easily fulfill the customers' wishes for delivery service. Figure 5.4 shows the relationship between the size of the warehouse and the company's delivery service.
Ved negativ leveringsinformation forstås: Negative delivery information means information to customers about, for example, non-delivery or delayed delivery.
Der vil som regel også være en klar samm: There will usually also be a clear correlation between the size of the warehouse and the company's logistics costs. This relationship is shown in table 5.5. It is obvious that a small inventory will result in lower storage costs than a large inventory. However, a small inventory will make it difficult for the company to process all customer orders on time. In cases where the goods must be packed and sent to customers in several batches (back orders), the company's packaging and transport costs will be increased.
Et lille varelager vil også betyde højer: A small inventory will also mean higher administrative logistics costs than a large inventory. This is because the company has to contact customers more often due to longer delivery times, poorer delivery compliance and reduced delivery flexibility.
Den forringede leveringsservice kan også: The degraded delivery service can also mean that the company will lose customers. This will result in increased shortage costs due to lost contribution margin on canceled customer orders and lost contribution margin on customers who choose to shop elsewhere in the future.
Hvis leverandørerne er ustabile eller ha: If the suppliers are unstable or have long delivery times, the company will often protect itself by having large stocks, especially up to e.g. Christmas shopping and special offers.
Hvis virksomheden handler med fx sæsonbe: If the company trades in, for example, seasonal fashion clothing, it will often have relatively large stocks leading up to the season. The company will thus ensure that it has the right goods when sales "break loose".
Forventninger om prisændringer kan også: Expectations of price changes can also influence the size of the inventory. If the company expects strong price increases in the near future, it will usually make large purchases with large inventories as a result. The situation will of course be reversed if falling prices are expected in the near future.
Hvis leverandørerne tilbyder kvantumsrab: If the suppliers offer quantity discounts, the company will often make large purchases per times to achieve the lowest purchase prices possible. It will also lead to large inventories.
Hvis omkostningerne ved at afgive ordrer: If the cost of placing orders for an supplier is relatively high, this will often lead to large purchases per unit. time in order to save purchasing costs in this way. Large inventories will thus arise, which entails large storage costs.
Det er dog forbundet med store omkostnin: However, it is associated with large costs to have a large inventory. This is primarily interest on the capital tied up in inventory. The risk of shrinkage (e.g. due to theft) and obsolescence also increases with the size of the warehouse. In the grocery industry, there is thus a great focus on minimizing losses due to perishable goods.
Lokaleomkostningerne vil derimod til en: The premises costs, on the other hand, will to some extent be independent of the size of the inventory. If the stock levels increase relatively much, however, the company may be forced to rent or purchase additional storage capacity, with the result that premises costs increase. The same problem applies with regard to wages for the warehouse staff.
Når en virksomhed overvejer at øge varel: When a company considers increasing inventory, the increased inventory costs must of course be weighed against the benefits expected from an improved delivery service. The benefits are measured in the form of the extra contribution margin, which is obtained from the larger product sales as well as any savings in the other logistics costs.

Lagermotiver er virksomhedens grunde til: Inventory motives are the company's reasons for having an inventory.
Hovedmotivet er ofte at yde en god lever: The main motive is often to provide a good delivery service. Other motives are, for example, to obtain quantity discounts, smooth out seasonal fluctuations and counter delays from suppliers.
En virksomheds lagermotiver afhænger af: A company's storage motives depend on several factors, e.g. industry and company type.
Detailbutikken bestiller varer hjem hos: The retail store orders goods home from the wholesaler in relatively small quantities. But still, consumers expect most stores to deliver immediately. If an item is not on inventory, the customer expects that the store can get it home quickly. The store then orders the product from the wholesaler, whose main function is to stock the manufacturer's range.
Når grossisten bestiller varer hos produ: When the wholesaler orders goods from the manufacturer, it is done in relatively large quantities. In order to provide a good delivery service, some manufacturers have a large inventory of finished goods and thus a high stock service level. Other manufacturers are made-to-order, which means that the goods are only produced when an order is received. This results in a relatively long delivery time.
Servicevirksomheder har på samme måde fo: Service companies similarly have different concepts. Some restaurants have very few dishes on the menu, and others have a very extensive menu. This places different demands on the warehouse management regarding which and how many raw materials must be available in the kitchen.
Varens holdbarhed har også indflydelse p: The product's durability also affects the size of the inventory. Many daily foods, e.g. fruit and vegetables, milk and fresh meat, have a limited shelf life. In order to avoid a large waste, no more items are ordered home than are expected to be sold. Fashion and seasonal goods are similarly ordered home in limited quantities. If such goods are purchased in too large a quantity, they are often sold close to the 'expiration date' at greatly reduced prices, often even at a loss, i.e. below the shop's cost price.
Varelagerets størrelse og sammensætning: The size and composition of the inventory is thus of great importance for the company's delivery service and logistics costs.

Indkøbsstyring udgør ligesom lagerstyrin: Purchasing management, like inventory management, forms an important part of the company's logistics, and the two management areas are closely linked. The purpose of procurement management is, among other things, to ensure that the right goods are present in the right quantities at the right times. The company must therefore decide when the goods must be ordered from the suppliers and how large quantities must be ordered home per walk.
En virksomhed kan disponere sit indkøb e: A company can dispose of its purchases according to the following two methods:
Ved indkøb efter bestillingspunkt fastsæ: When purchasing by order point, a minimum stock is set for each item. When the stock of the item reaches the set minimum, the company orders the item from the supplier. With this method, the purchase quantity is the same from time to time. See example in section 5.7.
Ved anvendelse af indkøb efter bestillin: When using purchase by point of order, an unexpectedly large sale or a major delay on the part of the supplier will mean that the company will be short of goods. However, this risk can be limited by the company establishing a safety warehouse, but this will increase the company's storage costs. To avoid this, the company can demand shorter delivery times and better delivery compliance from suppliers.
Ved periodisk indkøb bestiller virksomhe: With periodic purchases, the company orders the goods at fixed times, e.g. every day, every week or every month. How often the company chooses to purchase the item depends, among other things, on of the product's durability. With this method, the purchase quantity depends on how much has been sold since the last order. With each purchase, the company fills the warehouse up to a predetermined maximum stock.
Ved periodisk indkøb medfører et uventet: In the case of periodic purchasing, an unexpectedly large sale or a major delay on the part of the supplier means that the company will be short of goods if it does not have a sufficiently large safety stock. With periodic purchases, there is also a risk that too much time elapses between the set times for counting, and that the company thus overlooks that there are suddenly no items in stock.
Ved valg af disponeringssystem må man pr: When choosing a disposition system, one must try to weigh the advantages and disadvantages of the two systems against each other. Often the company will use point of order for most goods, but use periodic purchasing for goods with a limited shelf life or goods where the delivery system means that deliveries can only come at very specific times. In many cases, it will be practical conditions that determine which method will be the best to use.
I Fashion Shoe er der en række klassiske: In Fashion Shoe, there are a number of classic shoe models that repeat themselves through several seasons. For these shoes, the company uses purchase by point of order, as new shoes are ordered home when the stock reaches a certain minimum size.
De øvrige sko, som er mere sæsonbetonede: The other shoes, which are more seasonal, are purchased periodically. Here, the goods are purchased in larger quantities before the start of the season, as it is not always possible to re-order the models, as these may be sold out from the factory.
Når en virksomhed anvender indkøb efter: When a company uses purchasing by order point, the purchasing quantity is the same from time to time. As previously mentioned, the purchase size is important for both the company's inventory and order costs. The company has the opportunity to calculate the optimal purchase size, i.e. the purchase quantity that gives the overall smallest costs .

Når en virksomhed foretager et indkøb, o: When a company makes a purchase, order costs and inventory costs occur.
Ordreomkostninger kaldes også bestilling: Order costs are also called ordering costs or purchasing costs. In particular, they include labor costs for the time it takes to process the individual order. It concerns time for, among other things, order placement, goods receipt, control, bookkeeping and payment.
Ordre- (eller indkøbsomkostninger) er de: Order (or purchase) costs are the costs the company must incur in connection with processing an order.
Lageromkostninger omfatter bl.a. renter: Storage costs include, among other things interest on the capital invested in the warehouse, wages for warehouse personnel, costs for warehouse premises and shrinkage in the warehouse.
Lageromkostninger er de omkostninger, de: Inventory costs are those costs associated with maintaining the company's inventory. That is interest on the capital tied up in the warehouse (tied up money) as well as costs for the actual operation of the warehouse (rent, light, heat and wages).
Som nævnt handler indkøbsdisponering før: As mentioned, purchasing planning is primarily about buying goods home at the right time and in the right quantity. Large – and thus few – purchases will lead to high inventory costs, while order costs will then be low. Small – and thus many – purchases will result in high order costs, while the storage costs will then be low.
Den optimale indkøbsstørrelse pr. gang e: The optimal purchase size per times is the quantity where the sum of the annual inventory costs and order costs is the lowest.

Opgave 5.15: Logistisk effektivitet i In: Task 5.15: Logistic efficiency in Interiør A/S
Knud Gullmann i Guldhjertet har købt nye: Knud Gullmann in Guldhjertet has bought new furniture for private use. He traded in the furniture store Interiør. It was not without problems, however, but after two wrong deliveries and a delivery time of almost three months, he has finally been delivered the right furniture.
I Interiør A/S har man flere udstillings: Interiør A/S has several showrooms where customers can present the furniture in an exciting way. The individual exhibition rooms are close to each other.
Virksomhedens salg foregår ved, at kunde: The company's sales take place when the customer places their order for furniture, after which it is delivered to the supplier's home. Before the customer leaves the store, the clerk checks the delivery time with the supplier, and the customer is informed of when the goods can be expected to be delivered.
Forretningen har ikke et egentligt lager: The business does not have an actual inventory, but it does have a large back room where the furniture is stored until it is delivered to the customers.
Denne måde at drive forretning på har do: However, this way of doing business has led to a number of problems. It has therefore been decided to gather the sales staff for a joint discussion. At the meeting, i.a. following remarks:
Salgs- og indkøbschef Jørgen Kristofte: Sales and purchasing manager Jørgen Kristofte
Jeg har ved et tidligere møde nævnt, at: I mentioned at a previous meeting that we get too many complaints from our customers due to long delivery times, damaged goods and insufficient information about delivery times. Everyone can also see that there are many goods out in the back room. It can only be about goods that have not been delivered to customers or goods that have not been returned to our suppliers. In both cases, we are talking about goods that we have already paid for.
Når en kunde bestiller møbler, som skal: When a customer orders furniture that is to be delivered from several different suppliers, e.g. sofas, coffee tables and lamps, we only send the goods out to the customer when it has all arrived home. The customer wants the goods at once, and it also saves transport costs.
Vi har som bekendt ikke it-opkobling ude: As you know, we do not have an IT connection in the individual exhibition rooms, so we have to call the reception to inquire about delivery times etc. At the reception, Lise and Per answer the phone, print out order forms and invoices, set up customer accounts, receive payments and answer inquiries, etc. Sometimes they don't answer the internal phone at all. So that the customer does not have to wait too long, I therefore go up there myself and check the delivery times. Then I often see that there are old order forms that have not been sent to the suppliers. The specified delivery times are conditional on us placing the order on the same day that we receive the orders. We therefore often receive delayed deliveries.
Vi kan nu ikke beskylde receptionen for: We cannot now blame the reception for all delays. I have often experienced that I call out to a customer and tell them that we are now ready to deliver. I notify the drivers, but when they are about to load the goods onto the cart, the furniture is suddenly gone. They have either been sold or "borrowed" by someone else who just needed the furniture for his own customer. Then I have to go and order a new item. The delivery time is extended and the customer gets angry when I call to say that we can't deliver anyway. The other day a customer told me he didn't want a sofa or a table when we couldn't keep the deal. Luckily I didn't manage to order a new table, but what should I do with the sofa? It comes with a very special cover and it's still out in the back room collecting dust. If we're lucky, we can sell it on sale at a heavily discounted price.
Jeg har en gang imellem \"lånt\" nogle v: I have occasionally "borrowed" some items that were ordered for another customer. But when the goods are still there, we might as well take them. This reduces the delivery time on other orders and creates delivery flexibility. We have often been told that we must fulfill the customers' wishes. The customer is satisfied and the turnover increases. It can't be better. It should be added that I always make sure to reorder the item that I "borrow". There are others who "borrow" without re-ordering, and then things go completely wrong.
Så kan jeg bedre forstå, at vi nogle gan: Then I can better understand that we sometimes get the same item from the factory twice, when both myself and Mathias or others re-order "borrowed" items. These are double orders. But there is apparently no one who ensures that the goods are sent back to the factory.
Problemet er, at der på visse varer ikke: The problem is that there is no right of return on certain items. There are also factories that only accept returned goods if the faulty deliveries are "provably" their fault. In that case, we have to let the furniture go on sale.
Der står efterhånden så mange varer ude: By now, there are so many goods out in the back room that we have to constantly move them around when we have to load the car. It damages the furniture. Last week we had to pick up an expensive and beautiful sideboard from a customer that had some scratches on the surface. We have sent it in to the factory to have it polished up. I will refrain from telling what the customer thought about us.

Logistikprocessen i en produktionsvirkso: The logistics process in a manufacturing company
Iafsnit 5.2gennemgik vi logistikprocesse: In section 5.2, we reviewed the logistics process in a trading company. In a production company, the logistics process is expanded with a production department as well as the two warehouses for raw materials and goods under manufacture. As shown in the following figure, the number of activities is thus also expanded:
Vi har øverst i figuren (fra venstre mod: At the top of the figure (from left to right) we have the company's departments for sales, purchasing and production. It is the departments that plan how the received orders are to be implemented.
Nederst i figuren vises (fra højre mod v: At the bottom of the figure, the product flows are shown (from right to left). The goods are delivered from the company's suppliers and placed in the raw material warehouse. When the raw materials are later processed and sold, they are delivered to the customer. The goods flow also shows the external transport of the goods from suppliers to the production company and on to the customers.
Den eksterne transport foregår med enten: The external transport takes place with either external distributors (truckers and freight forwarders) or with the production company's own drivers and trucks.
Se ses, at den interne transport af vare: It can be seen that the internal transport of goods includes transport from the raw materials warehouse to the production department and on to the finished goods warehouse.
Endelig indeholder figuren en angivelse: Finally, the figure contains an indication of the orders that go between the company's internal departments and between the company and its external stakeholders, i.e. customers, suppliers and distributors.
Det viste eksempel begynder med, at virk: The example shown begins with the company's sales department receiving a so-called external order (sales order) from a customer (1). The sales department immediately investigates whether the goods can be delivered directly from the finished goods warehouse (2). If this is not possible, an internal order (requisition) goes to the company's production department (3), which immediately, through an internal order (production order), ensures that the production of the ordered goods starts (4).
Produktionsafdelingen beder samtidig ind: At the same time, the production department asks the purchasing department to investigate whether the company has the raw materials on inventory that must be used for the production in question (5). If this is not the case, the purchasing department issues an external order (purchase order) to the company's suppliers (6).
Når de bestilte råvarer modtages fra lev: When the ordered raw materials are received from the suppliers, they are included in the company's raw material warehouse (7), after which they are transferred to production to be included in the production process (8). When the goods are finished, they are transferred to the company's finished goods warehouse (9), after which they are distributed to the customer (10).
Det bemærkes at økonomiafdelingen ikke e: It is noted that the finance department is not part of the logistics process itself. The reason is that the finance department does not directly contribute to safe planning, implementation and control of an efficient flow of goods from the suppliers through the company and out to the customers.
Logistikprocessen er summen af de aktivi: The logistics process is the sum of the activities that are set in motion from the time the company receives an order until it is delivered. The activities of the finance department are not part of the logistics process.

Lagersystemet kan inddeles i tre faser:: The storage system can be divided into three phases:
Når en virksomhed køber varer hjem til v: When a company buys goods for the warehouse, a purchase order is issued. This triggers a purchase invoice and the goods are put into the warehouse when they arrive. This increases the value of the inventory, and there are more items to sell on to customers.
Ved salg af varerne udstedes en salgsord: When the goods are sold, a sales order and sales invoice are issued. Then the value of the inventory falls, which now becomes a consumption of goods and thus an cost . In return, the company has received an revenue in the form of a net turnover. The difference between net revenue and product consumption is the company's profit from the sale of the goods, also called gross profit.

Kreditorsystemet kan inddeles i tre fase: The accounts payable system can be divided into three phases:
Når en virksomhed foretager et indkøb af: When a company makes a purchase of goods from an supplier, the inventory is increased. If the purchase is not to be paid in cash, and the company can therefore wait, for example, 30 days to pay, an amount owed to the supplier arises. The company must ensure that this amount is paid on time, and the creditor module is a good help here.
Når virksomheden afgiver en ordre til en: When the company places an order for an supplier, they will often print a purchase order to the supplier. When preparing the purchase order, you enter e.g. supplier number as well as item number and quantity for each item. Based on the entered supplier number, the system automatically retrieves the supplier's name, address, etc., and based on the entered item numbers, the system automatically retrieves item names, prices, etc.
Ved varemodtagelsen kontrolleres det, om: When receiving the goods, it is checked whether you have received all the ordered goods and whether the amounts on the supplier's invoice correspond to what you have noted yourself. Once the supplier's invoice has been checked, the previously created purchase order can be approved for posting.
På dato for betalingsfristen overføres d: On the date of the payment deadline, the amount due is transferred to the supplier. The payment is recorded, and now the debt to the supplier will be smaller, while the company's liquid assets will of course be reduced.

Virksomheden kan altid se, hvor meget de: The company can always see how much it owes to the individual supplier and how much the company owes in total to the suppliers.
Kreditormodulet anvendes blandt andet af: The accounts payable module is used, among other things, by the company's buyers. Here the company's suppliers is created with, for example, contact information and payment terms, and here what the company buys from its suppliers is recorded. Debitorsystemet kan inddeles i tre faser: The debtor system can be divided into three phases:
Når virksomheden yder kredit til kundern: When the company provides credit to customers, it is important to keep accounts with how much you have to your credit with the individual customer. It is also important to make sure that you do not have too many receivables from customers, because then the company may run out of liquidity. This area is controlled in the debtor module.
Når der modtages en ordre fra en kunde,: When an order is received from a customer, a sales order is often printed. When the goods are ready for delivery, a sales invoice is printed. Since the customer has received credit, it must be registered in the debtor module that the company receives a receivable from the customer.
Forhåbentlig overfører kunderne de beløb: Hopefully, customers will transfer the amounts owed to the company on time. At the time of payment, the payment is registered in the system. After the bookkeeping, the receivables from customers will decrease, while the company's liquid assets will of course increase.

Hackere vil kunne finde sårbare data om: Hackers will be able to find vulnerable data about the company's various areas if they break into an ERP system. Therefore, there is a high risk of cyber attacks, which can be devastating for a company.
Ransomware og phishing-angreb udgør et s: Ransomware and phishing attacks pose a major problem as ERP systems are increasingly integrated across company departments. Several employees have been granted authorized access. All this significantly increases the risk of hacker attacks.
Man kan måske sige, at alt det som er en: You might say that everything that is an advantage when using an ERP system is at the same time a threat and thus a disadvantage. This does not mean that a company should drop the benefits of an integrated financial system, but it should pay close attention to protecting itself against the threats.

In the analysis, an income statement set up according to the contribution method is used, where the costs are divided into variable costs and capacity costs. It will thus be possible to assess how the variable costs and the capacity costs have each influenced the development of the company's earning power.

In other words, an increasing proportion of the turnover must have been spent on variable costs and/or capacity costs.

Det vigtigste nøgletal til analyse af in: The most important key figures for analyzing the earning capacity is the profit margin.
Overskudsgraden viser, hvor stor en del: The profit margin shows how much of the company's net revenue remains in profit when both the variable costs and the capacity costs are covered. In other words, the key figure describes the relationship between the company's net revenue and its costs.
Til beregning af overskudsgraden bruges: Profit before interest is used to calculate the profit margin. This is because the size of the interest costs depends solely on how much debt there is in the company. The interest costs therefore do not say anything about the company's ability to earn a profit.

I kapitel 7 har du set eksempler på, hvo: In Chapter 7, you have seen examples of how the implementation of plans, actions and recording of documents can affect the company's financial efficiency.
Følgende figur viser årsregnskabets hove: The following figure shows the main items of the annual accounts with a summary of the analyzes the company can carry out to optimize overall financial efficiency.
Ved optimering af resultatopgørelsen anv: When optimizing the income statement, a number of key figures are used, which can reveal whether the company is on the right track or needs to tighten up.
En optimering af balancen har fokus på b: An optimization of the balance focuses on both assets and liabilities. The company's assets must have the amount size necessary to ensure optimal operation. For example, the inventory must be large enough to meet the customers' needs. If it is greater, the company has spent unnecessary money. The liabilities, which must finance the assets, must have an appropriate distribution between equity and debt. The company must ensure that there is enough money for operations and that you do not pay too much in interest on loans.
I praksis viser det sig imidlertid ofte,: In practice, however, it often turns out that the plans and actions that are implemented do not result in the expected improvement. There can be many explanations why actions do not bring about the desired effect. Some internal factors the company itself has an influence on, e.g. sales prices, product range, location, employment of staff and sales promotion activities.
Faktorer i omverdenen har virksomheden k: The company has little or no influence on factors in the outside world. Customers, competitors and suppliers in the company's immediate environment can be influenced, but they can also largely influence the company itself.
Faktorer i fjernmiljøet som fx konjunktu: As a general rule, a company cannot influence factors in the remote environment such as economic and fashion fluctuations, trends and legislation. Here, the company must try as best as possible to exploit the opportunities and defend itself against the threats.
Der findes formentlig ikke nogle virksom: There probably aren't any companies that have unlimited resources to implement all the plans you want. Therefore, the big challenge is to prioritize between possible alternatives, and then implement the plans that, overall, expect to give the greatest possible economic efficiency.

Denne lærebog handler om virksomhedsøkon: This textbook is about business economics. One speaks of the "four economies", namely:
Videointroduktion til introduktionskapit: Video introduction to the introductory chapter
Verdens lande handler i stort omfang med: The countries of the world trade extensively with each other. Many countries also participate in various international economic organizations. As an example, you can mention the EU, which is an abbreviation for the European Union. One can also mention the international trade organization WTO (World Trade Organization), of which most of the world's countries are members. When you look at the commercial and economic relations between the countries of the world, you talk about the international economy.
Et samfund består af personer, private v: A society consists of individuals, private companies, organizations and institutions as well as the public sector. For example, when you look at society's total production, employment, income and consumption, you talk about the economy. This economy also includes tax collection and spending by the public. When you look at the economy in the individual regions and in the individual municipalities, you talk about the economy of the local community.
Den enkelte virksomhed råder over forske: The individual company has different resources at its disposal in the form of employees, equipment and money. It is up to the company to utilize these resources as best as possible. The individual company is largely influenced by the market in which the company's goods or services are sold. The company must continuously adapt to the competition so that it is able to survive.
I virksomheden skal der løbende træffes: In the company, decisions must be made on an ongoing basis about which activities would be best to carry out. It can be difficult to decide, as this often depends on future developments. In business economics, a financial yardstick (krona and øre) is used to determine whether it makes sense to make a certain choice. It is assumed that it is always necessary to choose the actions that give the best possible financial result for the company. We are talking here about profit maximization.
Gevinstmaksimering går ud på at vælge de: Profit maximization involves choosing the actions that are expected to produce the greatest possible financial result for the company.
I virkelighedens verden ser man dog også: In the real world, however, you also look at many other matters, such as the environment and ethics, when you have to make decisions.
De økonomiske forhold i de private husho: The financial conditions in private households (individuals and families) are mainly about adapting your costs to the revenue you have in the form of salary etc. In this context, we talk about the private economy.
Der vil løbende være et samspil mellem d: There will be ongoing interaction between the economies described. Private households receive wages from companies or the public sector.
Det offentlige modtager skatter og afgif: The public sector receives taxes and levies from both private individuals and businesses. Companies receive various subsidies from the public and from the EU, for example in connection with export promotion, environmental improvements and product development. The EU and various international organizations receive contributions from member states.
Virksomheder opnår indtægter ved salg af: Companies obtain revenue by selling goods and services to both private individuals, other companies and the public sector. And it could go on like this.
